- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 1.0) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -1.0), model underestimates; adjust downward by 3–7% to avoid missing downside risk.
- Model often overshoots after a sharp price spike (e.g., +10%+ above recent high); cap forecast at 1.5x recent high for 3–5 days.
- Forecast mean reverts too slowly; if 3 consecutive days show >1% deviation from true, apply 0.5–1.0% daily decay correction.
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to overreact to sentiment shifts; use 2–3 day smoothing on sentiment before weighting into forecast.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model fails to capture mean reversion; apply 1–2% downward bias in 3rd–5th day of cycle.
